method: Content links only: links inside #sp-component (Joomla main content area). Header menu, off-canvas menu and footer are excluded. Parents come from the URL path and the Leistungen hub (menu has no dropdown). Anchors are derived from page names and need a human edit. Targets are existing 200 pages only.
